Players Committee card image of [[Paploo (V)]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “While on Endor, Perimeter Patrol is suspended. Once per game, if in battle with a speeder bike (or two scouts), may relocate Paploo and one opponent's character of ability < 4 present with him (unless either are 'hit') to an adjacent site.” Uploaded unchanged.
